reaPath/reaQuery/socketUrl compose the base URL with a path handed to them. It builds no route of its own — the path always arrives from the caller or from the generated table — so it declares no rows.

THE ONLY ACCOUNT ROUTE THAT ESTABLISHES NOTHING. There is no sign-in route on the web API — `DecentAccountService` owns the credentials and ReaPrime signs in through its own Flutter UI, while `/account/proxy/<rest>` forwards an already authenticated request. The leaf reports and does not ask.

loggedIn:false DOES NOT MEAN 'not linked'. It also covers 'linked, but decentespresso.com could not be reached', 'linked, but the reply was neither an acceptance nor a rejection', 'linked, but the check did not finish within 30 s', and 'linked, but the last check was indeterminate and we are inside the 30 s cooldown' (decent_account_service.dart:495-499, :511-514, :516-581). Do not word a signed-out state as 'no account' on the strength of this route alone, and do not treat the first call of a session as cheap: it can block on an HTTP round trip for up to 30 s. At 8fee86dd that round trip HAS a deadline and an abort: verifyStoredCredentialsStatus wraps the check in a 30 s timeout that completes an abort trigger and answers indeterminate (:516-525), and _authedGet takes the AbortableRequest branch on this path (:743-749), where 42f67f69's untimed `_httpClient.get` branch (now :751-754) ran with no deadline.
rest.responseShape: 200 {loggedIn:bool} (account_handler.dart:12-14) — the answer is not 'an email is stored': isLoggedIn (decent_account_service.dart:489-509) requires BOTH email and password (hasLinkedAccount, :329-331) and then VALIDATES them against $baseUrl/support/api/login_test (verifyStoredCredentialsStatus, :516-581, through _authedGet :734-755, which on this path is given an abortTrigger, :545-550), bounded at 30 s: on the deadline the request is aborted and the result is indeterminate (:516-525). A settled verdict is cached in _authenticated and answered with no network call, a concurrent call joins the in-flight one (:493-494), and an INDETERMINATE result — the request threw (:551-556), the deadline passed (:518-523, :533, :557), or the reply was neither valid (200 with a non-empty token that is not '0') nor rejected (401, or a 200 whose token is empty or '0') (:558-569) — answers loggedIn:false (verifyStoredCredentials returns `_authenticated ?? false`, :511-514) and latches a 30 s cooldown (retryInterval, :90) in which every further call answers false without retrying (:495-499, :502-506)

notes: THE ROUTE THE 'no sign-in route' BLOCKER WAS HIDING. help-talk-to-decent stood as a read-only status for three days on the reasoning that the web API has no sign-in route. True — and an argument against a sign-in FORM, which nobody wanted. Sending a support message needs an ALREADY authenticated request, which is what this proxy forwards, with the account's credentials attached server-side by DecentProxyService.

TWO UPSTREAM ENDPOINTS, UNEQUALLY EVIDENCED. `support/api/email?subject&body` is corroborated inside ReaPrime — DecentAccountService.emailSerialMismatch builds exactly that URL with exactly those names. `support/api/emails` is NOT: no Dart file names it, and the only evidence it exists is the previous skin's own talkDecentFetchEmails. The proxy allows it because the allowlist is a PREFIX ('support/api/'), not a list of endpoints. That asymmetry is why the thread reports its own failure rather than rendering an empty conversation.

NO `since`. the previous skin passes it and keeps the thread in IndexedDB to compute it. This client asks for the whole thread every time — no second copy, no retention rule, and no query parameter with no evidence behind it.
